typography.usage: Use Cormorant Garamond (font-serif) for all numeric values (Wallet balance, betting numbers, results) and major H1s to exude wealth and authority. Use Outfit/Mukta (font-sans) for standard UI labels, warnings, and buttons.

visual enhancers.glows: Subtle text-shadow or box-shadow with #00D084 for active/winning states.
visual enhancers.textures: Avoid cheap generic gradients. Use deep solid colors with subtle optical borders.

component name.buttons: Do not use pill shapes. Use rounded-xl. Primary buttons should be solid bg-jade-500 text-obsidian-900 with .tactile-btn class. Secondary buttons should be transparent with 1px border-[#1A2D1F].
component name.cards: Apply .glass-panel. Left aligned Market Name (font-sans) and timings. Right aligned PLAY button (Jade) or TIMEOUT badge (Muted Obsidian-700 text-text_secondary, absolutely no red for timeout).
component name.bottom_nav: Floating island design. fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 rounded-full bg-obsidian-900/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-obsidian-700. Active icon is text-jade-500, inactive is text-secondary.
component name.betting_grid: Grid of 00-99 must have large touch targets (min 44px). Default state: bg-obsidian-800 border border-obsidian-700 rounded-lg. Selected state: bg-jade-500 text-obsidian-900 font-bold scale-[0.97].
component name.inputs: bg-obsidian-900 border border-obsidian-700 rounded-xl focus:border-jade-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-jade-500/20 text-white p-4.

grids.bento_dashboard: Use a 2-column or 4-column bento grid for quick actions (Deposit, Withdraw, Telegram, WhatsApp) with gap-4. They should feel like physical app widgets.

layouts.mobile_first: Ensure all touch targets are generous (min 44px). Padding scale should be slightly tighter on mobile (p-4). Container should have max-w-md mx-auto for desktop viewing.

motion.dashboard_load: Staggered fade-up for bento cards and market lists using Framer Motion (initial={{ y: 20, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.1 }}).
motion.interactions: All buttons must use active:scale-[0.97] for tactile, haptic-like feedback.
motion.wallet_balance: Subtle scale up and text-glow when balance increases.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-primary on surface colors exceeds 4.5:1.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all betting grid items and buttons.
accessibility.warnings: Use pulsing text (animate-pulse) in text-rose-500 for warnings instead of harsh blinking pure red.

media.icons: Use lucide-react with refined stroke widths (1.5px). Avoid standard generic SVGs if possible.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific fast-loading betting UI. Rely on 2D tactile neumorphism (inner shadows, scale down on click) to mimic physicality.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply this design strictly through Tailwind config modifications, global CSS variables, and updating shared component classes in the .js/.jsx files. DO NOT rewrite entire page structures unnecessarily. Replace generic red/black/gold Kalyan-Matka styling with this 'Jade Ledger' premium dark palette. Add the custom CSS utilities to index.css and extend the Tailwind theme. Implement the tactile-btn class on all clickables.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. 2. Use sonner for toasts, styled to match .glass-panel. 3. Do not center-align standard body text. 4. All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes. 5. Prioritize reusing existing components in src/components/ui. 6. Only share guidelines and modifications for .js/.jsx files.
